integrity: All proof obligations rest on explicit exact matrix computations and a 2-adic contraction argument; finite calculations support rather than prove the infinite theorem. No independent expert assessment is asserted.
limitations: The fixed coefficient pair (1,9) only; not a complete spectrum for all residues or a classification of all b congruent to 9 mod16.
